Taxes paid are used to bridge the gap between the rich and the poor.

Investment income refers to the money received in interest payments, dividends, capital gains realized with the sale of stock or other assets, including any other profit realised through an investment vehicle.

Capital gains tax is a tax charged where there is a disposal of assets.

Free trade is a trade policy that does not restrict imports or exports in a system.
